say:1:1610609001:1.text: Ah, Headmistress Durella. I see you've adapted to your new position rather swiftly. I must say, leadership rather suits you.
say:1:1610609001:1.source_cn: 你好，杜瑞拉女士，莱希拉姆的新代理校长，看来你很适应自...

say:2:1610609002:1.text: Your praise honors me, Master Aurelian. You remain as refined and sharp as ever.
say:2:1610609002:1.source_cn: 感谢您的夸奖，尊敬的奥瑞利安先生，您还是一如既往地充满...

say:3:1610609003:1.text: So it's true then, about Headmaster Leymar?
say:3:1610609003:1.source_cn: 所以，雷蒙校长的事情……是真的了？

say:4:1610609004:1.source_cn: 正是如此，奥瑞利安先生。

say:5:1610609005:1.text: A great mind, now gone. My condolences.
say:5:1610609005:1.source_cn: 噢，这可真是一件不幸的事情，我对此表示遗憾。

say:6:1610609006:1.text: Still, an institution of this caliber cannot afford to pause its progress. I'd recently prepared an investment proposal. I trust there's still someone authorized to see it through?
say:6:1610609006:1.source_cn: 不过我希望这件事不会对我们之后的合作产生不良影响……例...

say:7:1610609007:1.text: Of course, Master Aurelian. As acting headmistress, I am entirely at your disposal.
say:7:1610609007:1.source_cn: 不，当然不会，奥瑞利安先生，您知道我现在是代理校长，我...

say:8:1610609008:1.text: Excellent. Efficiency is a rare virtue in times like these. Though I notice you and your students seem in quite a hurry. I hope I haven't delayed you.
say:8:1610609008:1.source_cn: 这就好。对了，你和你的学生们行色匆匆……我不会影响到你...

say:9:1610609009:1.text: Not at all. We're merely on our way to meet the Lightbearer Envoy. Nothing too urgent.
say:9:1610609009:1.source_cn: 您的观察力依旧如此细致。我只是带他们去面见帝国特使而已...

choice_prompt:10:1610609009.text: Not at all. We're merely on our way to meet the Lightbearer Envoy. Nothing too urgent.
choice_prompt:10:1610609009.source_cn: 您的观察力依旧如此细致。我只是带他们去面见帝国特使而已，并不是什么十分紧要的事情。

say:11:1610609010:1.text: Yes. Well... we still have some time.
say:11:1610609010:1.source_cn: ……的确如此，但现在时间还很充足。

say:12:1610609012:1.text: Ah. I may have forgotten your name, but I remember your face. A promising young mage, wasn't it? And I believe I offered you a piece of valuable advice.
say:12:1610609012:1.source_cn: 啊，是你……虽然忘了你的名字，但我记得你是位充满潜力的...
say:12:1610609012:1.male: Ah. I may have forgotten your name, but I remember your face. A promising young mage, wasn't it? And I believe I offered you a piece of valuable advice.
say:12:1610609012:1.female: Ah. I may have forgotten your name, but I remember your face. A promising young mage, wasn't it? And I believe I offered you a piece of valuable advice.

choice_prompt:13:1610609012.text: Ah. I may have forgotten your name, but I remember your face. A promising young mage, wasn't it? And I believe I offered you a piece of valuable advice.
choice_prompt:13:1610609012.source_cn: 啊，是你……虽然忘了你的名字，但我记得你是位充满潜力的魔法学生。你或许也还记得我这位给予过你一句小小忠告的商人。
choice_prompt:13:1610609012.male: Ah. I may have forgotten your name, but I remember your face. A promising young mage, wasn't it? And I believe I offered you a piece of valuable advice.
choice_prompt:13:1610609012.female: Ah. I may have forgotten your name, but I remember your face. A promising young mage, wasn't it? And I believe I offered you a piece of valuable advice.

say:14:1610609013:1.text: What? I find it hard to believe anyone could forget about a gentleman as distinguished as Master Aurelian.
say:14:1610609013:1.source_cn: 什么？我很难相信有人会轻易忘记奥瑞利安先生这样的高贵绅士。
say:14:1610609013:1.male: What? I find it hard to believe anyone could forget about a gentleman as distinguished as Master Aurelian.
say:14:1610609013:1.female: What? I find it hard to believe anyone could forget about a gentleman as distinguished as Master Aurelian.

say:15:1610609014:1.text: How unfortunate. Forgetfulness is rarely an asset in business.
say:15:1610609014:1.source_cn: 噢，真可惜，一位健忘者很难成为我合作共赢的商业伙伴。
say:15:1610609014:1.male: How unfortunate. Forgetfulness is rarely an asset in business.
say:15:1610609014:1.female: How unfortunate. Forgetfulness is rarely an asset in business.

say:16:1610609017:1.text: In any case, you still have my card. I'm always open to mentoring bright young talents.
say:16:1610609017:1.source_cn: 无论如何，你有我的名片，我随时欢迎有潜力的年轻人来求教。
say:16:1610609017:1.male: In any case, you still have my card. I'm always open to mentoring bright young talents.
say:16:1610609017:1.female: In any case, you still have my card. I'm always open to mentoring bright young talents.

say:17:1610609018:1.text: I must take my leave now. With the headmaster's death made public, the Academy Board has quite a mess to sort out.
say:17:1610609018:1.source_cn: 我该走了，你也知道校长死亡一事曝光之后，学校董事会一下...

say:18:1610609019:1.text: Of course, I won't keep you from your work.
say:18:1610609019:1.source_cn: 当然，您一向事务繁忙，我就不打扰您了。

say:20:1610609020:1.text: Alright, everyone. Pick up the pace. The envoy's patience is limited.
say:20:1610609020:1.source_cn: 好了，大家加快速度，帝国特使恐怕已经等得不耐烦了。

choice:13:0:1.text: Sorry... I can't say I do.
choice:13:0:1.male: Sorry... I can't say I do.
choice:13:0:1.female: Sorry... I can't say I do.

say:22:1610609015:1.text: Titles... They're gilded ornaments that make one shine brighter. Just like the gold on a holy statue. Those golden parts attract more followers than you could ever imagine.
say:22:1610609015:1.source_cn: 头衔——金灿灿的装饰，正因为它们的存在你才会不断增值。...
say:22:1610609015:1.male: Titles... They're gilded ornaments that make one shine brighter. Just like the gold on a holy statue. Those golden parts attract more followers than you could ever imagine.
say:22:1610609015:1.female: Titles... They're gilded ornaments that make one shine brighter. Just like the gold on a holy statue. Those golden parts attract more followers than you could ever imagine.

choice:13:1:2.text: I would if I weren't busy trying to remember all your titles.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 我只记得你有很长一串头衔
choice:13:1:2.male: I would if I weren't busy trying to remember all your titles.
choice:13:1:2.female: I would if I weren't busy trying to remember all your titles.

say:23:1610609016:2.text: Precisely. The foundation of every prosperous relationship. I must say, remembering that makes you a rather promising investment.
say:23:1610609016:2.source_cn: 没错，合作共赢！你记住了最关键的内容，果真是具有高投资...
say:23:1610609016:2.male: Precisely. The foundation of every prosperous relationship. I must say, remembering that makes you a rather promising investment.
say:23:1610609016:2.female: Precisely. The foundation of every prosperous relationship. I must say, remembering that makes you a rather promising investment.

choice:13:2:3.source_cn: 我记得你喜欢合作共赢

choice:10:0:1.text: You just said we must not keep the envoy waiting.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 你刚说“不能让特使等太久”
choice:10:0:1.male: You just said we must not keep the envoy waiting.
choice:10:0:1.female: You just said we must not keep the envoy waiting.

say:24:1610609011:1.text: You! That was incredibly rude, interrupting Master Aurelian like that!
say:24:1610609011:1.source_cn: 你……在奥瑞利安先生面前随意插话是很无礼的行为。
say:24:1610609011:1.male: You! That was incredibly rude, interrupting Master Aurelian like that!
say:24:1610609011:1.female: You! That was incredibly rude, interrupting Master Aurelian like that!

choice:10:1:2.text: So is this an urgent matter or not?
choice:10:1:2.male: So is this an urgent matter or not?
choice:10:1:2.female: So is this an urgent matter or not?
